verdict.line: You lose if you walk into extended trades in Blinding Dart's 8s window; you win every time you force the fight while his Q is down or clear his blind outright.

brief.thesis: Teemo's entire lane kit is free ranged chip: Toxic Shot (E) poisons on every auto with no cooldown, and Blinding Dart (Q, 8s cooldown) periodically shuts off your return autos. But your W, Remove Scurvy, clears crowd control on cast — and Blind counts — so you have a direct answer to his one real lane tool that he doesn't have an answer for. That's why Gangplank holds a 51.5% win rate over 1,925 games here with the solo-kill edge.

theirWindow.when: His Q (Blinding Dart) is up, off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He will blind you on approach to cut off your autoattacks and deny Grog-Soaked Blade poison stacks mid-trade. Don't commit to an extended auto-trade here — poke with Q (Parrrley, 625 range) instead and disengage.

yourWindow.when: His Q is on cooldown (8s after use)
yourWindow.what: Walk up and trade freely — he has no answer to your autos or Parrrley for a full 8 seconds. Double-tap Q (Parrrley, 5s cooldown) during this window and stack poison with autos.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks a DOT burn on top of your own Grog-Soaked Blade poison every time you land a trade, which matters most since your trades are short, cooldown-gated windows rather than extended fights.

summoners.why: 51.4% win rate at 89.9% pick rate — Ignite matches his own Ignite in the all-in race and converts your solo-kill advantage into early kills; Flash covers dodging a blind-and-stick attempt or an R (Noxious Trap) zone.

playing.title: Track his Q, not your own cooldowns
playing.detail: Blinding Dart (8s cooldown) is the only thing that stops your autos. Every trade decision in this lane starts with whether his Q is up.

playing.title: Cleanse the blind and fight through it
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy, 18-22s cooldown by rank) clears crowd control on cast, including his blind. If he lands Q right as you commit, pop W and keep attacking instead of disengaging.

playing.title: Poke with Q during his cooldown windows
playing.detail: Parrrley (5s cooldown, 625 range) lets you match his 680-range harass without eating free Toxic Shot stacks for nothing in return.

playing.title: Respect camouflage near brush
playing.detail: If he stands still, he goes invisible and gains bonus attack speed on breaking it (Element of Surprise). Don't facecheck brush he's had time to sit in.

playing.title: Ward jungle entrances once he hits 6
playing.detail: Noxious Trap (R, 1s cooldown to place) turns tribrush and jungle paths into slow-and-damage zones. Check for mushrooms before pathing through contested vision.

playing.title: All-in when his Move Quick is down
playing.detail: His W passively speeds him up but resets if you hit him with an auto or Parrrley. Land the first poke to strip his escape speed, then commit with E (Raise Morale) for the kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune pages, boots, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured OP.GG data for Gangplank vs Teemo top on the current patch (16.19.1). The matchup read — cooldown tracking, the W-cleanses-blind interaction, and trade timing — is my own analysis of the ability kits, not OP.GG's.
